title: Torn-paper reveal 1.1.0 with a stronger default edge
problem: The 1.0.0 default jaggedness (0.012 of frame width) reads as subtle at contact-sheet scale; publish 1.1.0 with default 0.024 under the same bounds, leaving 1.0.0 pinned Plans unchanged.

catalogSearch.whyNotRecipe: Only torn-reveal@1.0.0 matches; a Recipe can set jaggedness per Recipe but cannot change the Capability default that the plan requires 1.1.0 to change.

acceptance: Same implementation behaviour as 1.0.0 with default jaggedness 0.024 (bounds 0.004-0.04).
Pass the same contained fixtures, fallback compile, and painter evidence gates as 1.0.0.

After promotion, the pinned 1.0.0 memory-torn Plans replay with unchanged Plan digests and painter frame hashes, and a Plan pinning a version removed from a scratch registry copy fails with FS_REPLAY_MISSING_VERSION.
